title: HostCover Theft Settlement Worksheet
content:
Under **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)**, the theft reimbursement starts from the loss the claims team verified on the approved theft claim. A theft claim bears an equal share of the stay's deductible: the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims filed on the same stay. From the verified theft loss, every guest payment recorded on the theft claim, net of reversals, is subtracted together with the theft claim's deductible share. The result is floored at 0.00 and then cut to the lowest of the level's theft sublimit, the level's per-claim limit and the plan's remaining aggregate, which is the level's annual aggregate limit less the reimbursements, net of recoveries, posted on the plan in the current plan year. The theft reimbursement is rounded half up to the nearest cent only at the end.

## Worksheet lines

1. **Verified theft loss**: the loss the claims team verified on the approved theft claim.
2. **Deductible share**: the plan level's deductible divided by the number of approved claims on the stay the theft arose from.
3. **Guest payments, net**: the guest payments recorded on the theft claim less any of them reversed.
4. **Net theft loss**: line 1 less line 2 less line 3, or 0.00 if that is below zero.
5. **Remaining aggregate**: the level's annual aggregate limit less the reimbursements posted on the plan in the current plan year, net of recoveries posted in it, never below 0.00.
6. **Ceiling**: the lowest of the level's theft sublimit, the level's per-claim limit and line 5.
7. **Theft reimbursement**: the lower of line 4 and line 6, rounded half up to the cent. No line before this one is rounded.

The deductible, the theft sublimit, the per-claim limit and the annual aggregate limit are the figures of the plan's HostCover level.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, not the figures of any level)

| Line | Value |
|---|---|
| Verified theft loss | 2400.00 |
| Level deductible 200.00; approved claims on the stay 3; deductible share | 66.666666… |
| Guest payments 500.00, of which 100.00 reversed; net | 400.00 |
| Net theft loss: 2400.00 less 66.666666… less 400.00 | 1933.333333… |
| Remaining aggregate: limit 30000.00, reimbursements this plan year 4000.00, recoveries 0.00 | 26000.00 |
| Ceiling: lowest of theft sublimit 5000.00, per-claim limit 20000.00 and 26000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Theft reimbursement | 1933.33 |

Had reimbursements this plan year stood at 29000.00 instead, the remaining aggregate would be 1000.00, the ceiling 1000.00, and the theft reimbursement 1000.00.
